title: Cymba marble cutaway mannequin — reference v5
direction: User's softly honed creamy marble reference, blank carved eyes, open matte stone cranial cutaway instead of glass, simplified stone brain and brainstem, pink auricular/cervical paths and violet cerebral illumination.
notes: Visual design and material references for future 3D modelling, not a validated medical anatomy map.
The central brainstem depiction and separate lateral nerve highlights are simplified. Anatomical positioning, continuity and generated-view geometry require reconciliation in the 3D model.
Ears are unobstructed for later earbud fitting.
No live site code or 3D model changed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Input image: user's chosen sculpture reference. Use its face, classical carved blank eyes, refined pale ivory marble, restrained mineral veining and sophisticated studio presentation as the design reference. The glass head is specifically unwanted.

Create a premium HEAD AND NECK stone sculpture for 3D earbud fitting, seen from a gentle three-quarter camera angle with nose toward image left. Neutral upright head, no raised chin or head tilt. Calm pleasant neutral expression, gently balanced facial features like the reference. Open eyes are plain blank carved ivory stone: no iris, no pupil, no eye texture or color, no wet eyes. No eyebrow hairs. Anatomically complete unobstructed ears. Head and neck only, clean flat cut at neck base, no shoulders/chest/pedestal. Remove the earbud and all cables from the reference.

MATERIAL: match the reference's refined softly honed creamy white stone, discreet warm-grey mineral veining and subtle fine grain. Satin-matte, tactile real carved marble, softer than heavily pitted limestone. Absolutely no coarse aggregate, craters, strong pitting, damaged surface, flesh or plastic.

REPLACE THE GLASS WITH A CARVED STONE CUTAWAY:
The upper side and rear of the cranium have an elegantly sculpted recessed open cavity, with a thin clean stone rim preserving the rounded outer head contour. It is a physical matte stone cutaway, OPEN TO AIR, not a transparent shell. The interior is the same soft ivory stone in gentle shadow. Within this recessed space are two very simplified smooth stone cerebral volumes with only a few broad sculpted grooves, not detailed brain gyri. A short simplified brainstem is visible at the back/lower part of the cranial cavity, anatomically behind and below the cerebral volumes, continuing toward the top of the neck. Keep the design quiet, minimal and gallery-like. NO glass, crystal, clear resin, glossy dome, reflective helmet, metal trim, gold rim or transparent material anywhere.

PINK/PURPLE NEURAL ILLUMINATION:
Sparse fine luminous lilac and pink inlays on the internal stone cerebral forms suggest stimulation across both hemispheres, using about 8-12 graceful curves, no detailed tree of tiny filaments. Make a clear focal connection at the lower brainstem/medulla inside the back of the head. Show the auricular branch from the ear's concha tracking BEHIND the ear toward the skull base, joining the vagal system there, never into a nerve in the temple. Distinct paired vagal pathways emerge at the sides of the skull base and descend down the LEFT and RIGHT lateral neck to the cut base. Highlight these two trunks clearly in pink-purple; they are separate from the short central brainstem and are NOT the spinal cord or one centerline down the neck. A discreet posterior carved recess can make the brainstem and paired vagal origins visible from rear views. Paths should be coherent when later shown from all angles. Illumination is tasteful, controlled, not neon floodlight; stone is dominant. No extra anatomy, labels or medical text.

Studio: pale neutral cool grey background matching #f5f5f7, large soft light, gentle shadows defining the stone and cavity, whole crown and neck base in frame, breathing room, realistic high-end physical render. No text, logos, watermark, clothing, jewelry, earbuds or wires. This is simplified anatomical concept sculpture, not a medical atlas.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: consistent four-angle modelling reference sheet.
Input: supplied ivory stone sculpture with an OPEN stone cranial cutaway. Preserve exactly this face, material, scale, blank eyes, gentle expression, overall shape and matte cutaway concept.

Create a square 2x2 reference sheet showing the SAME statue from four eye-level orthographic directions. Top left FRONT; top right LEFT PROFILE with nose toward right; bottom left RIGHT PROFILE with nose toward left; bottom right REAR. Four complete sculptures, equal size, consistent neutral upright head position and aligned neck-cut bases, full crown and base inside every cell, generous margins, no labels or dividers. Preserve the same head-and-neck geometry in every view. No shoulders, chest, earbud, cables or added pedestal.

Materials match the reference: creamy white softly honed marble with faint warm-grey mineral veining and very subtle fine grain. Smooth sculpted planes with a tactile satin-matte stone finish, not rough pitted limestone. Eyes open and filled with plain blank ivory stone, NO iris/pupil/rings/eye reflections. All ears anatomically complete and unobstructed.

NO GLASS anywhere. A clean open recessed cranial cutaway with a visible ivory stone wall thickness exposes simplified opaque stone cerebral volumes. No helmet, dome, clear covering, shiny rim, gold trim or transparent skull. The cavity is accessible from sides and upper rear. Preserve its geometry coherently across views, allow natural occlusion of internal objects.

PATHWAY AND BRAINSTEM DETAIL:
Inside the upper cavity, a small number of violet luminous channels cover the two cerebral volumes; only a few broad folds and graceful curves, not dense branching or a detailed anatomical brain.
Low and posterior within the cavity, show a short carved brainstem/medulla, clearly visible in the rear view through a tasteful opening in the posterior stone wall. The brainstem sits beneath the cerebral forms and IN FRONT of the back of the head. Mark a small pink brainstem relay there. Keep it separate from the cervical vagus trunks and higher purple cerebral activity.
On each side, a delicate pink auricular branch travels from the concha BEHIND the ear toward the skull-base vagal connection; no temple or eye-level brainstem.
EXACTLY TWO main slender pink/violet cervical vagal trunks descend from the sides of the skull base down the deep left and right lateral neck to its cut. Side views clearly show the appropriate side trunk; front shows the pair near the neck sides. Rear view shows the short central brainstem relay ABOVE the neck and BOTH lateral vagal trunks separately near the neck sides, revealed by shallow lateral stone recesses if needed. Do not extend the central brainstem into a glowing midline spinal cord down the rear neck. No third neck trunk, no vertebrae, no nerve mesh. Render visible parts coherently rather than relocating pathways to different surfaces for each camera.

Refined subtle pink and lilac illumination, stone remains dominant. Studio pale cool grey #f5f5f7 background, even soft key light and restrained contact shadows. Crisp clear geometry, focus throughout. No text, labels, logos, watermarks, jewelry, clothing, wires or extra objects.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Input image: four-view reference of a single open-cutaway stone sculpture. Use ONLY its LOWER RIGHT REAR VIEW as the exact subject and camera reference.
Create one standalone high-resolution rear portrait of this SAME sculpture, not a collage. Full crown, both ears and flat neck base visible with comfortable margin. Rear camera exactly level, neutral upright pose. Match the same refined creamy ivory honed marble and faint subtle veining, pale cool grey studio background, soft light, matte open stone cutaway; no glass, transparent shell or helmet.

Reproduce the posterior cranial opening with two simplified carved stone cerebral volumes and sparse delicate violet channels. Clearly show the SHORT STONE BRAINSTEM AND MEDULLA within the lower cranial cavity below the brain. Its pink light is a controlled luminous trace with a small relay point, not an oversized glowing ball. Show the paired vagal origins departing to either side of this lower brainstem/skull-base region, and the two pink/violet cervical vagal trunks descending along the LEFT and RIGHT sides of the neck to the cut base. Subtle carved side recesses expose these connections; do not sever them into disconnected fragments. Preserve a predominantly plain stone nape. NO glowing line down the center of the neck, no spinal-cord visualization, no vertebrae, no third cervical trunk. Auricular branches are glimpsed behind both ears. Keep brain stimulation simple, broad curves and sparse branching, no fine mesh.

The goal is a clean rear modelling reference that makes the relationship of brain, short lower brainstem, ear branches and paired descending vagal neck paths easy to read as a simplified sculptural concept. Stone stays dominant, lighting restrained, calm premium finish.
No text, medical labels, framing lines, logo, watermark, earbuds, cables, jewelry, clothes, shoulders, chest or extra objects.
